_comment: Authorization design of the portal, as data. The recorder creates exactly this in Power Pages design studio (Security > Table permissions / web roles); tests/design.test.mjs checks the invariants. Relationship names are the Dataverse defaults; confirm them in design studio.

webRoles.name: Customer contacts
webRoles.description: Contacts Contoso registered for a customer account. Assigned by Contoso staff, never by sign-up.

permissions.name: My contact record
permissions.why: AppendTo lets a new request point its Raised by lookup at the signed-in contact.

permissions.name: Requests I raised
permissions.why: Create with Contact access: the new record must be related to the signed-in contact. Write + AppendTo are what the documents subgrid needs to upload.

permissions.name: Colleagues at my company
permissions.why: Contacts whose parent account is my account. Reading them is the first hop to their requests.

pagePermissions.why: Hiding a page from navigation doesn't secure it (Learn, security best practices).
